context_requirements: Expression of TSPO (peripheral benzodiazepine receptor) or GABA-A receptor subunits
Proliferating tumour cells with intact mitochondrial apoptotic machinery
High Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Mcl-1 may be required for PK11195-like sensitisation
falsifiers: No change in proliferation or apoptosis markers at 24 h in any line
No transcriptional response at either 6 h or 24 h
Strong immediate upregulation of GABAergic or TSPO target genes at 6 h

evidence.supports: PK11195, a mitochondrial benzodiazepine receptor antagonist, lowers apoptosis threshold in cholangiocarcinoma cells
PK11195 has antiproliferative effects in mammary tumour cells expressing peripheral benzodiazepine receptor
Midazolam, a benzodiazepine, shows antitumour and anti-inflammatory effects in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
